::: {.tldr}
An LLM only knows what it saw during training. To answer questions about recent events, and to cite sources, it needs a search tool. Agents work best with search that returns **clean, structured data** rather than pages of links.
:::

## Why search?

A model without search has two weaknesses:

- **No fresh information**: it can't know last night's scores or today's weather.
- **No sources**: it can't point to where an answer comes from, so hallucinations are harder to catch.

## Regular search vs agentic search

| | Regular search engine | Agentic search (e.g. Tavily) |
|---|---|---|
| Returns | Links and raw HTML | Structured JSON, already filtered |
| Built for | A person reading a page | An agent processing data |
| Extra work | Scrape, clean, extract | Little or none |

## What happens inside a search tool

::: {.concepts}
::: {.concept}
`1 · Decompose`

Split a complex question into sub-questions.
:::
::: {.concept}
`2 · Route`

Send each sub-question to the best source. A weather question goes to a weather API.
:::
::: {.concept}
`3 · Extract`

Chunk the source and keep the most relevant pieces (vector search, top-K).
:::
::: {.concept}
`4 · Score & filter`

Rank the results and drop the weak ones before they reach the agent.
:::
:::

## Using Tavily

```python
from langchain_tavily import TavilySearch   # reads TAVILY_API_KEY from the environment

search = TavilySearch(max_results=4, include_answer=True)
result = search.invoke({"query": "What is in Nvidia's new Blackwell GPU?"})

result["answer"]                 # a short answer written by Tavily
for r in result["results"]:      # the sources
    print(r["title"], r["url"])
```

The same object can be handed to an agent as a tool: `Agent(model, [search], ...)`.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Remember
- Search gives an agent **fresh facts** and **citable sources**.
- People want readable answers. Agents want structured, minimal, relevant data.
- Good search = decompose → route → extract → score.
- Tavily needs its own API key (`TAVILY_API_KEY`).
:::

## Quiz

<details class="quiz">
<summary>What are the two main limits of an LLM without search?</summary>
<p>It has no access to recent information, and it can't cite sources.</p>
</details>

<details class="quiz">
<summary>Why is a JSON response better for an agent than a list of links?</summary>
<p>The agent can use the data directly. With links it would have to fetch, clean and extract each page first.</p>
</details>
